name: Machine Chest Press
image_match: Machine_Bench_Press. Seated bilateral chest press with a back pad and weight stack.

video_source: Life Fitness Australia, Insignia Series Chest Press demonstration.
info_source: Life Fitness, Insignia Series Chest Press.
form_cues: Set the seat so the handles meet the middle of your chest.
Keep your wrists straight and your back against the pad.
Press evenly with both arms and control the return.
instructions: Choose a pin-loaded, back-supported chest press. Set the pin while the stack is resting. Adjust the seat and start position so both handles are comfortably within reach.
Plant both feet, rest your back on the pad and take a secure grip. Use the neutral handles if available and comfortable.
Press both handles forward smoothly. Keep your shoulders down and stop before your elbows lock or your back lifts off the pad.
Bring both handles back under control within your comfortable range. Settle the stack before releasing the handles.
notes: Record the marked load on the machine you used. Follow your weekly plan for starting resistance, reps and symptom limits.
